pET-28a.description: T7-promoter expression vector with N-terminal 6xHis tag and kanamycin resistance

pUC19.description: High-copy cloning vector with lacZ MCS and ampicillin resistance

pACYC184.description: Medium-copy compatible vector (p15A ori); useful for two-plasmid systems

pRS316.description: CEN6/ARS4 centromeric low-copy episomal vector; URA3 selection; ~4.9 kb
pRS316.notes: Single copy per cell; stable, low expression. Part of the pRS CEN/ARS series.

pRS315.description: CEN6/ARS4 centromeric low-copy episomal vector; LEU2 selection; ~4.9 kb
pRS315.notes: Low-copy centromeric vector; stable inheritance. Use in leu2Δ strains.

pRS314.description: CEN6/ARS4 centromeric low-copy episomal vector; TRP1 selection; ~4.9 kb
pRS314.notes: Low-copy centromeric vector. Use in trp1Δ strains.

pRS313.description: CEN6/ARS4 centromeric low-copy episomal vector; HIS3 selection; ~4.8 kb
pRS313.notes: Low-copy centromeric vector. Use in his3Δ strains.

pRS416.description: 2-micron high-copy episomal vector; URA3 selection; ~4.9 kb
pRS416.notes: High-copy (~20–40 copies/cell). Promoter-less backbone; insert your own promoter-GOI cassette. Part of pRS 2-micron series.

pRS415.description: 2-micron high-copy episomal vector; LEU2 selection; ~4.9 kb
pRS415.notes: High-copy (~20–40 copies/cell); promoter-less MCS. Use in leu2Δ strains.

pRS414.description: 2-micron high-copy episomal vector; TRP1 selection; ~4.8 kb
pRS414.notes: High-copy (~20–40 copies/cell); promoter-less MCS. Use in trp1Δ strains.

pRS413.description: 2-micron high-copy episomal vector; HIS3 selection; ~4.8 kb
pRS413.notes: High-copy (~20–40 copies/cell); promoter-less MCS. Use in his3Δ strains.

pYES2.description: 2-micron high-copy episomal vector with GAL1 promoter; URA3 selection; ~5.9 kb
pYES2.notes: High-copy 20–40 copies/cell; galactose-inducible expression. Pre-loaded with GAL1 promoter.

pESC-HIS.description: Dual-promoter 2-micron high-copy vector; GAL1 and GAL10 opposing promoters; HIS3 selection; ~6.7 kb
pESC-HIS.notes: Two independent MCS driven by opposing GAL1/GAL10 promoters. Useful for two-gene co-expression under galactose induction.

pESC-URA.description: Dual-promoter 2-micron high-copy vector; GAL1 and GAL10 opposing promoters; URA3 selection; ~6.7 kb
pESC-URA.notes: Identical architecture to pESC-HIS but URA3 marker; 5-FOA counterselectable.

pESC-LEU.description: Dual-promoter 2-micron high-copy vector; GAL1 and GAL10 opposing promoters; LEU2 selection; ~6.7 kb
pESC-LEU.notes: Identical architecture to pESC-HIS but LEU2 marker. Use in leu2Δ strains.

pESC-TRP.description: Dual-promoter 2-micron high-copy vector; GAL1 and GAL10 opposing promoters; TRP1 selection; ~6.7 kb
pESC-TRP.notes: Identical architecture to pESC-HIS but TRP1 marker. Use in trp1Δ strains.

pRS306.description: Integrating vector (URA3); integrates at ura3 locus after linearization; ~4.9 kb
pRS306.notes: Linearize within URA3 to direct integration at the ura3 chromosomal locus; stable single-copy expression. URA3 marker is split by insert so integrants can be counterselected with 5-FOA for loop-out (pop-out).

pRS305.description: Integrating vector (LEU2); integrates at leu2 locus after linearization; ~4.9 kb
pRS305.notes: Linearize within LEU2 to direct integration at leu2 locus. Stable single-copy expression in leu2Δ strains.

pRS304.description: Integrating vector (TRP1); integrates at trp1 locus after linearization; ~4.9 kb
pRS304.notes: Linearize within TRP1 to direct integration. Stable single-copy in trp1Δ strains.

pRS303.description: Integrating vector (HIS3); integrates at his3 locus after linearization; ~4.8 kb
pRS303.notes: Linearize within HIS3 to direct integration. Stable single-copy in his3Δ strains.

pCAMBIA1305.1.description: Binary vector with GUS-PLUS reporter under CaMV35S; hygromycin plant selection, kanamycin bacterial selection
pCAMBIA1305.1.notes: T-DNA contains GUS reporter + NOS terminator

pCAMBIA1300.description: Binary vector backbone without reporter; hygromycin plant selection

pBI121.description: Classic binary vector with GUS + NOS terminator under CaMV35S; kanamycin selection

pK2GW7.description: Gateway-compatible binary vector; 35S promoter, spectinomycin bacterial selection
